notes.subject: moahlodi
notes.rationale: מוכיח: 'umpire/arbiter/daysman/mediator' — yo a fapanang ka mehla ga bapalami ba khotso; 'moahlodi' ke kgetho ya gona, eupša 'moemedi' goba 'morweledi' le a dumelwa

notes.subject: yo a rekišago magareng
notes.rationale: מוכיח ka boikokobetso ke 'yo a ka laolago khotlokgolo' — motho yo a beago seatla godimo ga bapalami ba babeli

notes.subject: לא יש
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re 'aowa go na le' — ga go yo; ⟨gona⟩ ke lentšu le okeditšwego la Sepedi

translation: Ga go ⟨gona⟩ moahlodi magareng ga rena, yo a ka bjeago seatla sa gagwe godimo ga rena bobedi.
